Resolve descendant PowerShell through PSHOME and use its built-in Start-Sleep.
Both existing Windows tests set PATH to empty using the shared TestHostEnv lock and restore it on Drop.
Preserve production deadlines, fixture ready barrier, PID liveness and eventual cleanup assertions.
test_parallelism: Repository default; no test-threads override or serial annotation added. Existing environment mutation lock is used by the two fixture-owning tests.
